data.title: The number below the rent
data.situation:
Back at her desk, Lin opened the advert for the nearer flat and drew two columns in her notebook: Every month and Before moving in. She wrote £1,100 under monthly rent in the left-hand column. There were still empty lines underneath. The advertised price was not the whole answer.

She called the estate agent about the bills. He confirmed that utility bills were extra and that a deposit was due before she received a key. Lin added the names of those costs, then opened the draft contract. Its heading said “Lease”. She read down the page, looking for the kitchen window repair she had asked about. Nothing on the page mentioned it. She left her pen beside the notebook rather than signing.

Lin: Are utility bills included in the monthly rent?
Agent: No, they are extra. The deposit is paid before you collect the key.
Lin: Are there any other charges? And when is the first payment due?
Agent: I will send you the payment details.
Lin: Thank you. I also need an answer about the kitchen window.

Thank you for explaining the bills. Please send me the full cost and payment dates. The draft lease does not mention the kitchen window. Could you put the repair plan in writing before I sign? Once I have those details, I can decide whether to go ahead.
data.goal: Separate recurring costs from an upfront deposit, clarify extra charges, and request a written term before signing.
data.zhSupport: 广告租金不是全部费用。林把每月支出与入住前付款分开，再核对合同是否写入她提出的维修要求。先开口询问，再看示例。

glossary.note: rent 在这里是名词；monthly rent 说的是每月租金，不一定包含账单。

glossary.zh: 水电煤等公用事业账单
glossary.note: 通常指电、水、燃气等费用；是否包含在租金里要问清。
charge 在这里是可数名词；问 Are there any extra charges? 可确认附加收费。
move in 指搬进新住所；before moving in 常用于说明押金等付款时间。
询问或写明首笔款项何时支付；具体款项应在合同中说清。
签合同前提出条件的常用说法；sign 后省略了前文提到的协议。
这里是名词，指房屋租金；也可作动词，表示租用。
charge 的复数名词形式；这里指租金之外的收费。
在租房语境中指入住前支付的保证金；退还条件应看协议。
名词，可指付款行为或一笔款；first payment 是首笔付款。
名词，泛指有约束力的协议；租房时应核对其中的书面条款。
名词，指约定房屋租用条件与期限的协议；可说 sign a lease。
本课名词；常用复数charges询问多项收费，不使用指控或充电动词义。

glossary.zh: 询问某项目是否已计入价格
glossary.note: 询问某项目是否已计入价格；主语单数用Is，复数用Are，不默认报价已含账单。

retrievalPrompts.function: Clarify what the quoted rent includes
retrievalPrompts.cue: The advertised price looks affordable, but you do not know whether water and electricity cost extra. Ask the agent.
acceptableAnswers: Are utility bills included in the monthly rent?
Does the rent include water and electricity bills?
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Ask about the full recurring cost, not only the advertised figure. Either a natural question with utility bills or a plain-English question is useful.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 广告上的价格看起来负担得起，但你不知道水和电是否另收费。问中介。
checks: 询问水电账单是否包含在月租中。
清楚说明所核对的价格范围，不只问一个无对象的总数。
可用账单名词，也可直接问租金是否包括水费和电费。
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: Are utility bills included in the monthly rent? 用 Are 对应复数 bills；Does the rent include…? 用 Does 后接原形 include。included in 说明计入哪项价格，两种问法都在核对持续支出。
retrievalPrompts.answerRangeZh: 可用 utility bills，也可列出 water and electricity。须问清是否计入月租，不能据广告价格自行断言已经包含；不要求同时使用两种问法。

retrievalPrompts.cue: Explain which housing costs come every month and which amount is paid before moving in.
acceptableAnswers: I would pay the rent and utility bills each month, and a deposit before moving in.
The rent and bills are monthly costs; the deposit is paid before I move in.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Keep the time distinction clear. A deposit is an upfront amount; the agreement should explain the exact conditions attached to it.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 说明租房哪些钱每月付，哪一笔要在拿钥匙前交。
checks: 区分持续支出和入住前付款。
不把保证金说成每月费用。
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 这里的时间区别比把所有费用名字堆进一句话更重要。

retrievalPrompts.function: Ask about extra charges and payment timing
retrievalPrompts.cue: One fee appears below the advertised price, and you do not know when the first amount is due. Ask two short questions.
acceptableAnswers: Are there any extra charges? When is the first payment due?
What extra charges will I pay, and when do I make the first payment?
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Charges are additional amounts asked for. Ask for both the amount and the due date instead of guessing from the advert.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 广告价格下还有一项费用，首次付钱的时间也不明。提出两个短问题。
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 不要根据广告自行猜测收费或到期日期。

retrievalPrompts.function: Request a written condition before signing
retrievalPrompts.cue: You asked whether the kitchen window could be repaired, but the draft agreement does not mention it. Say what you need before signing.
acceptableAnswers: Could you put the window repair in the contract before I sign?
Could we add the window repair plan to the lease before I sign it?
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Identify the missing repair condition and request a written change. Contract is a general agreement word; lease is a more specific property agreement word.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 你问过修厨房窗户，但协议草稿没有提及。说清签署前你想补进的约定。
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 可以用一般合同词，也可以识别更具体的租赁协议词；不要求两个都使用。

transferPrompt.function: Transfer cost and contract questions without the story or an image
transferPrompt.cue: A campus room advert gives a monthly price, but electricity costs extra. You must also hand over a sum of money before you receive the key, and may get it back later. Without reopening Lin's story, ask for the full ongoing cost and ask for one condition about when money is due to be written into the agreement.
acceptableAnswers: Could you tell me the total monthly cost, including electricity? Please put the deposit payment date in the contract before I sign.
Could you tell me the total monthly cost, including the electricity bill? Could the date for the first payment be written into the lease?
transferPrompt.feedback: This is a new room with different costs. Ask for a complete monthly figure and one clear written term; exact wording may vary.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 另一间校园房按月收费，电费另付；拿钥匙前还要交一笔以后可能退还的钱。询问完整每月费用，并要求把一项付款时间写进协议。
checks: 询问这间校园房的完整每月支出，包含另付电费。
提出一项付款时间的书面要求，如保证金或首笔款项何时交。
请求写进协议，不将以后可能退还的保证金说成必定退还。
transferPrompt.feedbackZh: 电费已知另付，因此应问 total monthly cost 或问电费怎样计入每月支出，单问是否包含还不完整。deposit 和 first payment 可以分别询问何时到期；put…in the contract 或 written into the lease 表达书面要求。
transferPrompt.answerRangeZh: 可问总月费，也可请求说明租金加电费的计算方式，不必假定电费固定。须保留完整持续费用与一项付款时间写入协议；可只选保证金或首笔款项，不要求同时列所有费用。
acceptableAnswersZh: 能告诉我包括电费的每月总费用吗？请在我签字前把保证金付款日期写进合同。
能告诉我包括电费账单在内的每月总费用吗？能把首笔付款日期写进租约吗？

readingBlocks.en:
Back at her desk, Lin opened the advert for the nearer flat and drew two columns in her notebook: Every month and Before moving in. She wrote £1,100 under monthly rent in the left-hand column. There were still empty lines underneath. The advertised price was not the whole answer.

She called the estate agent about the bills. He confirmed that utility bills were extra and that a deposit was due before she received a key. Lin added the names of those costs, then opened the draft contract. Its heading said “Lease”. She read down the page, looking for the kitchen window repair she had asked about. Nothing on the page mentioned it. She left her pen beside the notebook rather than signing.
readingBlocks.zh:
回到书桌前，林打开近处公寓的广告，在笔记本里画了两栏：每月、入住前。她在左栏的月租下写上1,100英镑。下面还留着几条空行。广告价格并不是完整答案。

她打电话问中介账单的事。中介确认水电等账单另付，并且拿钥匙前要交保证金。林补上这些费用名称，再打开合同草案。抬头写着“租约”。她逐行读下去，寻找此前询问的厨房窗户维修安排。页面上没有提到。她把笔放在笔记本旁，没有签字。

readingBlocks.en:
Lin: Are utility bills included in the monthly rent?
Agent: No, they are extra. The deposit is paid before you collect the key.
Lin: Are there any other charges? And when is the first payment due?
Agent: I will send you the payment details.
Lin: Thank you. I also need an answer about the kitchen window.
readingBlocks.zh:
林：水电等账单包括在月租里吗？
中介：不包括，要另外付。保证金在取钥匙前交。
林：还有别的收费吗？第一笔钱什么时候付？
中介：我会把付款详情发给你。
林：谢谢。厨房窗户的问题，我也需要答复。

readingBlocks.en: Thank you for explaining the bills. Please send me the full cost and payment dates. The draft lease does not mention the kitchen window. Could you put the repair plan in writing before I sign? Once I have those details, I can decide whether to go ahead.
readingBlocks.zh: 谢谢你说明账单情况。请发给我完整费用与付款日期。租约草案没有提厨房窗户。能在我签字前把维修安排写下来吗？拿到这些细节后，我才能决定是否继续。

data.easySummary: Lin writes down costs paid every month and costs paid before moving in. Bills are extra and a deposit is due before she gets a key. The repair is missing from the draft contract, so she asks for it in writing and waits before signing.
data.easySummaryZh: 林分别写下每月支出和入住前支出。账单另付，拿钥匙前还要交保证金。合同草稿没有维修计划，她要求写下来，并暂缓签署。
